wins.text: Q1 revenue of $12.7B came in at the high end of guidance range, driven by better-than-expected Xeon sales
Non-GAAP gross margin of 39.2%, approximately 3 percentage points above guidance on stronger-than-expected Raptor Lake demand and improved Meteor Lake costs
Q1 EPS of $0.13 vs. guidance of breakeven, driven by higher revenue, stronger gross margin, and lower OpEx
Operating expenses down $400M sequentially and $700M year-over-year; OpEx targets lowered to $17B in 2025 and $16B in 2026
Altera stake sale to Silver Lake at ~$9B valuation with Intel receiving net cash proceeds of $4.4B; IPU revenue expected to double from 2024 to 2025

risks.text: Q2 revenue guided to $11.2B–$12.4B, down 2%–12% sequentially, with wider-than-normal range due to tariff and macro uncertainty; gross margin guided to ~36.5%, well below Q1's 39.2%
Intel Foundry operating loss of $2.3B in Q1; Intel 7 capacity constrained 'for the foreseeable future' due to stronger-than-expected Raptor Lake demand crowding out newer nodes
Macro and tariff uncertainty increasing probability of recession; CFO flagged potential TAM contraction and noted June is likely to be softer than the strong start to Q2
Lunar Lake margin headwind persists due to memory-in-package cost structure; 18A ramp start-up costs will pressure gross margins through 2025
No Tier 1 external foundry customer announced; AI accelerator portfolio gap acknowledged with Falcon Shores cancelled and Jaguar Shores still in development with no firm timeline

guidance_items.detail: Q2 guided to $11.2B–$12.4B (midpoint $11.8B), down 2%–12% sequentially vs. historical flat seasonality; wider-than-normal range due to tariff/macro uncertainty
Q2 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~36.5%, down from Q1's 39.2%, on lower revenue and mix shift to outsourced/lower-margin client products
Q2 non-GAAP EPS guided to breakeven, down from Q1's $0.13
2025 gross CapEx target lowered to ~$18B from prior ~$20B guide; net CapEx range maintained at ~$8B–$11B
2025 OpEx target lowered to $17B (from ~$17.5B prior); 2026 OpEx target set at $16B

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Viability of the IDM model given persistently negative Intel Foundry gross margins and whether the structure needs to be reconsidered
Status and timeline of external/Tier 1 foundry customer wins for Intel 18A
Rack-scale networking strategy and Intel's ability to compete in AI cloud infrastructure build-out
